title: Case trajectories in the lake, the owner's fraud run against its earlier run and solution, and binary certified on Telco and HyperAck
request: Phase 8: the case_trajectories lake family; the owner's fraud (private, rules only) with its resolved recipe against RPB-007 and the owner's own solution; Telco and HyperAck certifying binary and the modifiers.
plan: A case_trajectories builder: a whole case per built project, refused below its minimum.
A real run's comparison against its previous run and the owner's earlier solution, with its limits, stored privately.
Binary certified on its replica and the two real datasets with their traps.

decisions.decision: The fraud run is stored under agent_runs, never in evidence.
decisions.why: The data is the owner's and private (D6): only the owner's machine keeps its numbers.

decisions.decision: The earlier solution is set beside, never ranked.
decisions.why: It was measured on its own protocol and split, not DCLab's.

change: dclab_core.datasets (case_trajectories, manifest v8 reading v1 to v7); dclab_rnd.datasets._case_items; the lake's solution_design mapping; dclab_rnd.real_problems (PRIVATE_RESULTS, previous, comparison, the recipe in the number); dclab_rnd.certify (REAL_FOR, FAMILY_OF, entries_for, run_kind for engine kinds); the data catalog's builder note.

findings.defect: A v7 manifest no longer read.
findings.scenario: The lake's test read an older manifest after v8.
findings.cause: The upgrade validator stopped at v7.

findings.defect: No run's comparison was stored and the binary path had no test.
findings.scenario: The real runs and the binary certification were not run.
findings.cause: The package's code was built before its runs.
findings.fix: The fraud run stored with its comparison (private); entries_for tested; the binary certification run as CRT-003.

findings.defect: A test patched a minimum the function never re-read.
findings.scenario: CASE_MIN_PROJECTS patched to 10, the default bound at definition.
findings.cause: A default argument is bound once.
findings.fix: The patch is gone; the test reads the default.

measurements.name: the owner's fraud, rules only, against RPB-007 and the earlier solution (private)
measurements.gate: stored with its comparison and its limits
measurements.result: average precision 0.019 (cluster bootstrap 0.0003 to 0.088 over 692 groups), the same as RPB-007 (difference 0.0); the earlier solution's own protocol: random forest 0.095, PU bagging 0.081
limits: Each number is one holdout of its own protocol: a difference inside the intervals is not a difference.
The earlier solution was measured on its own split: set beside, never ranked.

outcome: The lake gets a family of whole cases once ten projects exist; the owner's fraud is carried by the rules to a number far below the owner's own model, said with its interval; binary is certified on two real tables.
lessons: Store a comparison with the protocol of each side, or the numbers will be read as a ranking.
A default argument cannot be patched: read the module constant at call time or pass it.
risks: The rules' fraud number is low: the review list and the rings are not in this run.
